concerns.text: FR-003 requires constructing the CSA Adoption Index and validating it against the survey data schema. T018 implements feature engineering but lacks an explicit task to perform the validation against the schema defined in data-model.md or the contract, leaving the 'validating the index' requirement unassigned.

FR-002 and the 'Edge Cases' section require automatic village-level aggregation if N < 300. T021 is marked [UNRESOLVED-CLAIM] with status=not_enough_info, meaning the specific logic for this fallback is undefined. Without a resolved task, the system cannot satisfy the requirement to handle low-overlap scenarios.

FR-005 mandates calculating VIF scores for all predictors. T025 contains a placeholder `{{claim:c_0b367ab0}}` and an unresolved claim marker for the VIF logic. This makes the task unimplementable and leaves the VIF calculation requirement unfulfilled.

SC-005 requires the sensitivity analysis to 'demonstrate that the variation magnitude... is measured and documented'. T030 generates the plot and CSV, but there is no distinct task to interpret these results or explicitly document the 'variation magnitude' in the final report text, risking incomplete fulfillment of the success criterion.

The Spec 'Study Design' and Plan 'Scale/Scope' require a target N > 1000 or village aggregation justification. T053b is marked [UNRESOLVED-CLAIM] regarding the sample size justification. Without a resolved task, the project lacks the required statistical power justification.

T017a contains an [UNRESOLVED-CLAIM] marker. While the logic is described, the unresolved status indicates the task definition is incomplete, which is a writing/definition flaw preventing clear execution.
